name: In situ transport critical-current measurement of a REBCO coated-conductor bridge at 40 K during 14 MeV D-T neutron irradiation (ISIS NILE)
plain_name: Watch a superconducting tape lose current-carrying ability while fusion neutrons hit it at 40 K
description: A 4 mm x 20 um EuBCO+Hf bridge in a custom cryostat with a 1 mm Al window is held at 40 K and biased at 115-120% of Ic (up to 7.65 A) under 14 MeV neutrons (up to 7.3e7 n cm-2 s-1); periodic I-V curves track Ic versus fluence, with 40.0-42.0 K calibration and a vacuum room-temperature anneal.
keywords: Watch a superconducting tape lose current-carrying ability while fusion neutrons hit it at 40 K

sources.citation: Adams et al., The performance of REBCO coated conductor during in situ cryogenic irradiation with fusion-spectrum neutrons, Supercond. Sci. Technol. 39 (2026) 02LT01

reported_equipment: custom NILE cryostat (ISIS Neutron and Muon Source)
Adelphi Technologies compact D-T neutron generator

requirements.rationale: Constant bias currents up to 7.65 A.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
